preconditions.description: The input 'n' must be a positive integer.

postconditions.description: The function should return an empty string if 'n' is 0 or a negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(result[i] == str(n - i) for i in range(len(result)))
postconditions.description: Each line in the result should be a string of numbers starting from 'n' down to 'n - i', where 'i' is the index of the line.
The number of lines in the result should be equal to 'n'.
